A few permissions, each for a reason
Nothing is shared until you add people to your circle. Camera and microphone are used only during an SOS.
So your circle and SOS alerts know exactly where you are.
Keeps sharing working after a restart, without opening the app.
On the next screen choose \"Allow all the time\". Your location is only ever shared with people in your circle, and you can pause sharing anytime.
For SOS alarms from family, and to show when sharing is on.
Used only during SOS: live video and audio for your circle, saved as evidence.
Hold Volume Up for 6 seconds to trigger SOS, even from the lock screen.

Android calls this an accessibility service. It only listens for the Volume Up key and never reads your screen.\n\nIn Settings: Accessibility → Installed apps (or Downloaded apps) → Women Safety → turn it on.
If the switch is greyed out (\"Restricted setting\"): open App info → ⋮ menu → \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Texts your SMS contacts during SOS — works without internet.
Lets an SOS alarm from your circle wake your screen.
Stops the phone from pausing sharing and SOS alarms to save battery.
Texted with your location during SOS. Works without internet, and they don\'t need the app.

Hold Volume Up for 6 seconds. After 2 seconds you\'ll feel light ticks; three strong buzzes mean SOS has started.\n\nIt works inside other apps and on the lock screen. When the screen is fully off, some phones don\'t pass the volume key to apps — wake the screen first (press power) if nothing happens.

• Your live location is visible only to people you add with your QR code, and you're notified whenever someone joins.
• Camera and microphone are used only while your SOS is on.
• Evidence is kept on your phone, and copied to your private cloud space so it isn't lost if the phone is taken.
• No passwords, no ads, nothing sold.
This removes your profile and contacts from this phone and disconnects you from your circle. Saved evidence stays in the Evidence vault.
Photos and audio recorded during each SOS. Kept privately on this phone.
Nothing here yet. If you ever start an SOS, photos and audio will be saved here automatically.
The photos and audio will be removed from this phone. Copies already sent to the cloud are kept.

Hold Volume Up for 6 seconds to send SOS

Lets you trigger an emergency SOS by holding the Volume Up button for 6 seconds — inside any app and on the lock screen.\n\nThis service only listens for the Volume Up key. It does not read your screen, your messages or anything you type, and the volume button keeps working normally.

string-array.name: safety_tips
string-array.item: Before a cab ride, share the vehicle number with your circle.
Practise the volume SOS once today so your hands remember it.
112 is India\'s single emergency number. 1091 is the women\'s helpline.
In an unfamiliar area, walk where there are shops and lights — even if it\'s longer.
Keep your phone above 20% battery when travelling at night.
Agree on a code word with family that means \"call me now\".
Trust your instincts. If a place feels wrong, leave and tell someone.
